name: fable-advisor
description: Run your session on a flagship-tier Claude model as a full-time architect that writes delivery contracts and verdicts, while a Grok-family lane (via the Grok CLI) and a GPT-family lane (via Codex; currently GPT-6 Astra by default) own the implementation within them, plus an in-house Opus lane the architect routes to deliberately, which also keeps it working without the CLIs.
